author: blu
body: Proves Drain Life. "{B}{B}, deals X damage to any target; you gain that much life." is authored as the DrainLifeX marker; the engine pours spare mana into X, deals it to the reach-aware burn target (here the opponent's face, since there is no creature to kill), then gains the caster X life. This is the X-damage path plus lifegain. The demo casts Drain Life for X=3 into an empty board: the opponent loses 3 and the caster gains 3, and the card goes to the graveyard.
